gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Flavors has a towering x-height, like a stubby carpenter's pencil stroke. Flavors goes whimsical and commanding with unpinched curves, while Noto Sans Gurmukhi tidies up behind it, terminals pointing outward like tongs.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Chunky and a bit cheeky, Flavors keeps its joins full-bodied where strokes meet, never thinning out. Noto Sans Hanunoo brings the legibility: lowercase filling most of the height, with open terminals.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Flavors has no stress axis tilting its round letters, so its towering x-height stands up like a stubby pencil stroke. Noto Sans Hebrew follows with wide curve gaps, letting the heading lead.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-hk: Noto Sans HK reads large and tight, its lowercase crowding the ascenders, with brush ends lifted before curves close. Flavors earns its keep big and short, its tube-like strokes constant in width.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-imperial-aramai: Whimsical but firm, Flavors draws a steady, unshaded outline under its towering x-height. And Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic reads approachably over many lines, its c ends pointing apart like open pincers.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional-p: Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian reads clean and open, with big eyes on every e and a and a deep middle band. Flavors adds round-tipped-pen whimsy up front, so the body text can simply do its quiet work.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-jp: Loud and level, Flavors draws every line with no pressure variation, its x-height towering like a pencil stroke. Flavors grabs attention; Noto Sans JP sweeps its tall curves open.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Reading here is easy, the lowercase filling the line like capitals, while Flavors goes whimsical in flat stencil weight. Noto Sans Kaithi handles the sustained reading, leaving the big, commanding moments to Flavors.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Noto Sans Kannada rises gently from small letters to capitals, with s curves that open wide at both ends. But Flavors never mixes bold-looking and light-looking strokes in a word, and that consistency is what holds it together.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Paperclip-bent and playful, Flavors has no swelling anywhere, just its towering x-height. And Noto Sans Kayah Li stays tidy beside it, capitals barely taller than lowercase and brush ends lifted away.
